correctness.rationale: Because the pointwise maximum chooses radii independently, the squared norm is max over 3^5 matrix Gram spectral radii, and nonnegative matrices have a nonnegative top singular vector. Dihedral action yields exactly 39 mask classes, with five patterns in the unique winning orbit (0,1,0,2,2). An independent fresh exact-rational program reconstructed all 243 masks and 39 orbits and checked Sylvester positive definiteness of 1463/1000 I−A^T A for all 38 competing orbit classes; witness (7,2,7,1,1) yields 17141/11700>1463/1000. Direct determinant on three-dimensional even block gives 225λ^3−390λ²+91λ−4=0; positive Gram Perron vector gives unique modulus and strict maximizing radii. This is an exhaustive finite optimization proof, not samples.
